name: residential_quotient_wrap
description: Test 13: GetTractQuotient keeps the population sum in 16 bits. Pops (40000, 30000, 0), EQ (10, 10, 10): s = 0 x 10; s = 30000 x 10 + s; (40000 x 10 + s) = 700000; the sum 70000 wraps to 70000 - 65536 = 4464, so 700000 / 4464 = 156.81004 (one float32 rounding). GetCellEQ(x, z) reads tract (x / 4, z / 4): cell (3, 3) is tract (0, 0); cell (4, 0) is the empty tract (1, 0) -> 0.
